# Agent identities of OTHER deployments, which may not appear in a commit of this
# repository (.github/check-commit-identity.py). People are not limited and are
# never listed here, nor are this project's own agent and release bot.
#
# Each line is a salted hash from `check-commit-identity.py --hash`: an address or
# a whole `@domain`. A plain address here would itself publish who those
# deployments are, so the gate refuses one, and neither a comment here nor a commit
# message or pull request that changes this file may name them.
#
# The gate reads this file from the BASE of the pull request, never from its head,
# so a pull request cannot drop an entry to let its own commits through. An empty
# or unreadable file fails the gate. `#` starts a comment.
